purpose: Non-executable GNX P1 rootfs comparison requirements; records what evidence to collect without naming URLs or digests.

checks.evidence: official source identity, license/SBOM, support window, exact rootfs digest in sealed manifest

checks.accept: x86_64 or amd64 for GNX linux-amd64

checks.evidence: imported as GNX-0.3.1 under expected owner; no adoption of existing distro
/etc/wsl.conf has systemd=true, automount=false, interop=false, appendWindowsPath=false after bootstrap/restart
systemd is PID 1 or otherwise passes GNX host prerequisite checks
podman is available and can run release-pinned containers without unpinned install-time downloads
compressed rootfs bytes, imported WSL size, post-bootstrap size, free /var/lib space
package inventory, enabled services, open listeners before GNX apply, host integration state
doctor/plan/apply/status JSON and G0-G6 observations; missing gate remains FAILED or ACTION_REQUIRED

decision_policy.candidate: ubuntu-24.04-lts-official-wsl only if sealed as an authenticated importable rootfs with recorded digest and passing host gates
decision_policy.alternative: ubuntu-base-amd64 if size/surface goals justify additional bootstrap evidence
decision_policy.reject: any option with unpinned install-time downloads, unverifiable provenance, missing required tools, failed WSL/systemd/Podman gates, or premature READY
